<div class="card-body">
'''Hoth: Mountains (6th Marker)''' is a [[Dark]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ホス：山脈</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここを支配しているなら、フォース消耗に＋1。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここには自分の帝国軍と戦闘用ビークルを－1で配備できる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Hoth-Mountains-6th-Marker-SWCA-97589.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Hoth: Mountains (6th Marker).

'''Light Side:'''
If you control this site, add 1 to the Force drain.

'''Dark Side:'''
Your Imperials and combat vehicles may deploy here for 1 less.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese title uses 山脈 (mountain range) and 第6マーカー (6th marker).
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Hoth: Mountains (6th Marker)]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
